authored.author: Mojive contributors
authored.description: Original Electron editor action masters using Mojive's adopted canonical grid and stroke policy. These extend the Electron catalogue without changing native renderer or gizmo geometry.

semantics.camera-align: Align an authored camera to the current editor view: a camera, an outgoing direction arrow and a destination view corner. Distinct from Reset, View Camera, Pilot and Capture image.
semantics.favorite: A five-point star marks favorite model assets, distinct from the bookmark used for scene snapshots.
semantics.asset-library: A collection of outlined tiles represents the model library, distinct from the project file folder and viewport layers.
